method: Fresh offline page with real UI clicks. Playwright advances one hour for elapsed service, so this is compressed progression, not sixty elapsed wall-clock minutes. Day7 comes from the public-command 45-day economy bot. No unlock shortcuts or injected currencies. The first-hour route uses skip; the day7 route attempts to reach its boss, which uses real x1 playback if reached. An earlier defeat remains recorded and day7BossReached is false; it is not evidence of boss timing. P6 has a separate fixed level6/chapter-unlock timing benchmark. These are different fixtures and outcomes remain explicit.
